name: Panic! at the Dog Show
source:
Elyse and her chihuahua Francis are taking part in Kansas' largest dog show this year, but something isn't quite right.

As you get ready for the dog show yourself, you can reach out to the other dogs and dog owners to help out with the strange occurrences or take advantage of the situation. Oh, and did I mention that the dogs talk?

- Talk to the dogs of the dog show!
- Investigate strange happenings!
- Try to win and become #1 dog in Kansas!

[From [url=https://moosader.itch.io/dog-show]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝和她的吉娃娃弗朗西斯正在参加今年堪萨斯州最大的狗展，但有些事情不太对劲。

当你自己准备好狗展时，你可以联系其他狗和狗主人来帮助解决奇怪的事件或利用这种情况。哦，我有没有提到狗会说话？

- 与狗展上的狗交谈！
- 调查奇怪的事件！
- 努力获胜并成为堪萨斯州排名第一的狗！

[来自[url=https://moosader.itch.io/dog-show]itch.io[/url]]
